text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on May 28, 2020, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition submitted by Councillor Gord Perks, Ward 4, Parkdale-High Park, regarding bikeways on Bloor Street, Danforth Avenue, Yonge Street, and on other busy Toronto Transit Commission surface routes, containing the names of approximately 5,478 persons.
